data.title: Why Hot-State Homeowners Are Choosing Wood Pergolas Over Aluminum -- It's Not About Looks
data.description: In Payson, Utah, on August 21, 2026, a report reveals a surge in the outdoor living trend in the Sun Belt region. A notable concern is emerging in the pergola market regarding safety. It has been observed that metal surfaces exposed to direct sunlight can lead to contact burns within seconds, whereas heavy timber materials prove to be safer to touch. This has sparked a significant shift in the market, prompting companies like Western Timber Frame™ from Utah to reassess their product offerings.

data.title: Hasanuddin University Study Maps Indonesia's Seagrass Ecosystems from Hotspots to Refugia
data.description: In Makassar, Indonesia, a recent study conducted on 21 seagrass meadows in Central and Eastern Indonesia has uncovered a diverse ecological landscape. The assessment, published in Science of..., highlighted a wide variation in the health of these areas, with some remaining relatively healthy while others were found to be degraded. The study sheds light on the importance of conserving these ecosystems, as they play a critical role in the region's biodiversity.

data.title: Klarna to Present at Upcoming Investor Conference
data.description: New York - Klarna, the everyday finance network, revealed its plans to participate in the upcoming investor conference in September. The company will be present at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on September 9 at 3:05 p.m. PDT, with Niclas Neglen, CFO, representing Klarna. data.title: AMC Robotics Enters into Warrant Inducement Transaction for up to $2.1 Million in Gross Proceeds
data.description: On August 21, 2026, AMC Robotics Corporation (Nasdaq: AMCI) announced entering warrant inducement agreements with two investors for the exercise of certain outstanding warrants issued in December 2025. The investors agreed to exercise these warrants at a reduced price of $1.65, generating $1 million in gross proceeds through the Initial Warrant Exercise. Additionally, they have the option to exercise the remaining warrants at the same reduced price, potentially raising up to an additional $1.1 million within 30 trading days. Currently priced at $4.017 per share, the warrants allow for the acquisition of common stock. This resale has been registered under an effective Form S-1 (File No. 333-292488).

data.title: RenovoRx Regains Compliance with Nasdaq Minimum Bid Price Requirement
data.description: RenovoRx, Inc., a biotech company based in Mountain View, California, has successfully regained compliance with the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC's minimum bid price requirement for continued listing on The Nasdaq Capital Market. The company, trading under the symbol RNXT, focuses on developing targeted oncology therapies and distributing their patented FDA-cleared drug delivery device, RenovoCath®. This recent development was announced on August 21, 2026, signifying the company's commitment to meeting market standards and maintaining its foothold in the industry.

data.title: Star Equity Holdings, Inc. Declares Cash Dividend of $0.25 Per Share of 10% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock
data.description: Star Equity Holdings, Inc. headquartered in Old Greenwich, Conn., revealed that its Board of Directors declared a cash dividend for holders of the Company’s 10% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, with a payout of $0.25 per share.
